crossRefs.note: You shall do to Ai and her king as you did to Jericho and her king, except you shall take its goods and its livestock…
So Joshua arose, with all the warriors, to go up to Ai. Joshua chose thirty thousand men, the mighty men of valor, and…

people.name: Ai
people.line: A Canaanite city conquered by Joshua after initial defeat.

people.name: Bethel
people.line: Important city in Israel, associated with Abraham and Jacob.

translations.web: He took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
translations.bsb: Now Joshua had taken about five thousand men and set up an ambush between Bethel and Ai, to the west of the city.
translations.kjv: And he took about five thousand men, and set them to lie in ambush between Bethel and Ai, on the west side of the city.
translations.asv: And he took about five thousand men, and set them in ambush between Beth-el and Ai, on the west side of the city.
